name: Death pit fall

v1.prompt: Cartoon comedy: the cat looks down in surprise, legs scramble in the air, then it falls straight down, flailing, with a shocked face, getting slightly smaller as it drops. Keep the cat's size until it drops.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: usable: nose-down plunge with a shocked open mouth; the cat is drawn smaller than other clips from frame 0 (scale to match); reads more as a dive than a scramble
suggest: frames 2-14 at 16 fps (~0.8 s), scaled up to match
